page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening) with one column of text; a narrow strip of the facing right page with partly visible margin notes at the far right edge, not transcribed as text here. Page number and running head at the top; no notes in the left margin.

main_text.p: variis modis inter se temperatarum complexiones variæ: Igitur marmor calorem habet, etiam dum gelidâ plus urit glacie: & humor est in pumice; cui ne guttam quidem unam exprimas sub artissimo torculari. Inter hæc, & id genus alia, à quorum longius persequendo catalogo, deterreor nauseâ, nulla ratiocinantium sensa; omnia sic volentium placita sunt: Ac miror Placitorum etiam nomine censeri ab iis, quibus oraculorum instar sunt: Nempe quæstionem gravem in mendaces habet Veritas: & quæ rebus nomina conveniunt, ea nihil ejusmodi cogitan-

page.notes: The right-hand page is only partly visible at the edge (fragments of margin notes such as "publica", "Narura"); these are not legible enough to transcribe. The catchword "cogitan-" is printed at the line end as a hyphenated continuation and is kept in the text. The signature "E 4" is faintly visible below the text. Line "iis," is printed with a superscript-like mark after "iis" which is reproduced as printed.
